name: Peachtree Borer
desc: Peachtree Borer (Synanthedon exitiosa): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Synanthedon exitiosa, the peachtree borer, is a species of moth in the family Sesiidae that is native to North America. The adult female of the species has a wingspan of about 3.5 centimeters.
